name: triz-problem-solving
title_zh: 矛盾先摆上桌，再谈方案：带证据的 TRIZ 解题流程
tagline_zh: 需求互相打架、同一个 bug 修了三轮、架构选型怎么选都亏——它不急着给答案，先把矛盾抽成参数对。
tagline_en: When requirements fight, fixes repeat, or every architecture choice loses something: it extracts the.
desc_en: Structure difficult engineering, software, research, or process problems using evidence-aware TRIZ analysis. Use when requirements conflict, fixes repeat, architecture choices create trade-offs, or the user requests TRIZ or ARIZ. Skip routine implementation with an established solution.
why_zh: 多数 AI 会直接跳到方案，它先逼你把「要快又要稳」写成技术矛盾或物理矛盾，矛盾没定清楚就不往下走。
why_en: Most AI jumps straight to solutions. This one forces the trade-off into a technical or physical contradiction first, and won't.
limit_zh: 只做问题结构化，不写代码、不做实现；已有成熟解法的常规开发任务它会直接劝退。ARIZ 全流程很长，赶工期别用。
limit_en: Structures problems only — writes no code, does no implementation. Skips routine tasks with known solutions. Full ARIZ is long; not for tight.
title_en: Evidence-aware TRIZ: map the contradiction before the fix
